input.text: Root reviewed aws_local.py toolchain(): Node is currently selected from pin["node_path"], which is the absolute /opt/codex development runtime path. This makes the shipped adapter unusable on another installation even with identical pinned Node bytes. Use an explicit physical operator-selected Node executable path (e.g. CLOUD_NODE_BIN) and verify its fixed version/hash; keep machine acquisition paths only in verification evidence, not required product configuration. Update actual tests and local contract accordingly, including alternate installed location with the same trusted bytes and wrong-byte denial. Do not add PATH/workspace fallback or change trust/hash requirements. Also ensure report clearly states the actual supported asset subset: publish_assembly currently admits JSON/template files and cdk.out, not arbitrary CDK file/zip assets.

scope: in-turn implementation feedback, not a quality verdict
